The '''Mos Espa Combat Hall''' was a building in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:ME" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was the headquarters and training facility of the [[Mos Espa Militia]].<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Combat Hall}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Mos Espa Combat Hall was the site of heavy fighting during the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|Invasion of Mos Espa]]. Citizens trained there by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Berok Skoff]] were pivotal during the defense of the city.<ref name="SWG:TA" />
